A class purse is a small fund contributed to by members of a class and managed for the benefit of the entire class. It is used to support academic and social activities such as printing materials,class projects and other collective needs, including the purchase of class items like speaker batteries and markers for presentations and announcements. The purse promotes cooperation, responsibility, and transparency among class members, ensuring that shared expenses are handled efficiently for the smooth running of class activities.

Help Us Bring LinkedIn Local to KWASU – Empower the Next Generation of Professionals!

We’re hosting LinkedIn Local KWASU, the first-ever professional networking event at Kwara State University — a platform where students will learn how to build their LinkedIn presence, connect with mentors, and access real career opportunities.

This event is 100% student-led, and we need your support to make it a success!

Your donation will help us provide:
- Quality event setup and logistics  
- Free professional headshots for students  
- Guest speaker sessions and workshops  
- Resource materials and branding sessions  
- Certificates and growth tools

Our goal is to bridge the gap between classroom learning and real-world career readiness — and you can be part of that change.

Every naira counts. Every share matters.
Let’s equip KWASU students for life after school.  

Thank you for believing in this vision! 🙏🏽
